question: Should this branch remain a combined public feed/follow/notification stack, or should it be split/restacked after the base follow API and notification slices land?
rationale: The branch carries multiple open draft dependency slices plus durable schema/API changes, and automation cannot choose the permanent product/API boundary or merge order for maintainers.

options.title: Restack after base slices
options.body: Require the base follow API and notification/control slices to land or be retargeted first, then review the feed-route branch against a clean merge result.

options.title: Review as one stack
options.body: Treat this PR as the combined feature stack and require maintainers to own the broader API, data model, and UI scope in one review.

options.title: Pause the direction
options.body: Leave the draft parked until maintainers decide whether publisher follows and feeds should ship in this shape.

recommendation.title: Restack after base slices
recommendation.body: Require the base follow API and notification/control slices to land or be retargeted first, then review the feed-route branch against a clean merge result.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen owns much of the current route/schema/API baseline that this stack extends, making them the best available routing owner from history.
